content.title: Diamondbacks vs. Dodgers: Prediction, Lineups, TV, Stream (3/27)
content.text: The Arizona Diamondbacks (0–1) and the Los Angeles Dodgers (1–0) continue their Opening Week series tonight at Dodger Stadium. The defending champs opened the season in dominant fashion on Thursday, rolling to an 8–2 win over Arizona. The Diamondbacks got on board first with a two-run homer off the bat of Geraldo Perdomo in the top of the fourth off Yoshinobu Yamamoto. But the Arizona bats went silent after that, with Los Angeles retiring 18 of the final 19 batters and preventing any late-game momentum. Yamamoto finished the six-inning outing allowing two runs and five hits, while striking out six. The Dodgers’ bats responded with four runs in both the fifth and seventh innings to break the game open, with the biggest swing coming from Andy Pages, who knocked out a three-run homer. Will Smith added a home run and finished with three RBIs. Pages and Smith went 2-for-4, while Shohei Ohtani and Kyle Tucker each had a hit. On the mound tonight, both teams turn to right-handers coming off productive 2025 campaigns. Ryne Nelson was a steady presence for Arizona, going 7–3 with a 3.39 ERA across 33 appearances (23 starts), logging 154.0 innings with 132 strikeouts and an impressive 1.07 WHIP. Opposing him is Emmet Sheehan, who delivered an efficient and at times dominant season for Los Angeles, posting a 6–3 record with a 2.82 ERA over 15 appearances (12 starts). In 73.1 innings, Sheehan struck out 89 batters with a 0.97 WHIP. Expect a Dodgers win, but a tighter result than last night’s blowout, given Rhine’s success against Los Angeles. He allowed four runs over 11 innings against the Dodgers last season. Prediction: Los Angeles Dodgers 5, Arizona Diamondbacks 3 Starting Lineups Arizona Diamondbacks Ketel Marte — 2B Corbin Carroll — RF Geraldo Perdomo — SS Gabriel Moreno — C Pavin Smith — DH Nolan Arenado — 3B Carlos Santana — 1B Alek Thomas — CF Jordan Lawlar — LF Starting Pitcher: Ryne Nelson — RHP Los Angeles Dodgers Shohei Ohtani — DH Kyle Tucker — RF Mookie Betts — SS Freddie Freeman — 1B Will Smith — C Max Muncy — 3B Teoscar Hernández — LF Andy Pages — CF Alex Freeland — 2B Starting Pitcher: Emmet Sheehan — RHP How to Watch Diamondbacks vs. Dodgers First pitch is scheduled for 10:10 PM Eastern / 7:10 PM Pacific at Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles.
